title: Change of coefficients and base change for the diagonal class
statement:
1. Extension of scalars along $\Zl\to\mathcal O_E$ carries $\delta_{\Zl}$,
   $\operatorname{Tr}_q$ and the integration identities to $\mathcal O_E$-linear
   morphisms $\delta_{\mathcal O_E}$, $\operatorname{Tr}_q$ satisfying the same
   identities, whose reductions modulo $\pi_E^n$ (equivalently modulo
   $\ell^n$) are the torsion classes and traces.
2. Inverting $\ell$ and passing to the filtered colimit over finite
   extensions of $E$ inside $\Qlb$ gives $\delta_E$, $\delta_{\Qlb}$ and their
   traces, with the same identities.
3. For a separated morphism of finite type $g:Y'\to Y$ of the standing
   setting, the pullbacks of $\delta_\Lambda$ and $\operatorname{Tr}_q$ along
   the base changes of $g$ are the corresponding morphisms for $Y'$.

proof.text: Obtain the three completed trace Results, their fixed projective models, the supported sources and both integration identities from diagonalTower_trace.
Use diagonalCompletedDiagram_realization to transport the whole completed class, traces and identities to a condensed Z_ell Diagram with its Reference.
Apply diagonalCoefficientFamily_extension, preserving the initial diagram literally, and obtain its Reference.

For E, pi and n, finite quotient comparison supplies finiteness; the explicit ell^(n+1) annihilator follows from ell in the maximal ideal. Invertibility of ell pulls to W and passes to powers. Apply diagonalCoefficient_uniformizerFiniteComparison at r=n, and assemble exactly the existential data in QuotientCompatibility. This gives every FiniteReductions entry. Construct both kernel-normalized finite root comparisons explicitly with cartierRootsIso at this killing exponent.

For the actual g, construct BaseSquares by pullback hom extensionality. Use the whole-system Cartier, supported-source and trace-splitting base-change comparison for the non-torsion coefficient stages. This gives the root comparisons and the Z_ell, integral, rational and closure compatibility fields.

For every quotient diagram pair in FamilyPullback, combine its two scalar squares with the integral pullback field, by the scalar/pullback compositor and the perfect quotient comparison. Assemble these quotient data and the non-torsion fields into FamilyPullback. No other class or family is chosen.

tool_uses.why: The coefficient-ring finite-freeness, exact inverse-image coefficient identification, and Tate-twist identification are generic coefficient tools outside the diagonal-tower unit.
The integral-limit, localization, and filtered finite-subextension colimit descriptions are generic coefficient tools used to form the E and Qbar stages.
The explicit completed O_E coefficient limit is a generic coefficient construction used to identify the reductions.
Pullback compatibility for the coefficient limit, localization, and Qbar colimit is supplied by this generic coefficient-system lemma.
Commutation of q_* and p_i* with bounded-below filtered colimits is the generic pro-etale continuity tool used in rationalization.
The closed-support unit/counit supplies closed base change for the supported coefficient source, required explicitly by blueprint paragraph (3).
Exactness, colimits, composition, and the direct-image evaluation formula justify the inverse-image diagrams.
The generic monoidal derived pullback comparison supplies naturality of tensoring the Cartier complex and the coefficient stages.
Verifies the Noetherian hypothesis of the projective-line decomposition for the standing schemes.
Exact filtered colimits identify the cohomology of the colimit complex with the colimit of cohomology in step 2.
